title: Endometriosis and Migraine
official: Mechanisms Underlying Endometriosis and Migraine Comorbidity
summary: This study aims to determine differences in experimental pain and sex hormone levels between patients with migraine, patients with endometriosis, patients with migraine and endometriosis, and healthy controls. Participants will complete surveys, experimental pain paradigms and collection of samples for hormone analyses.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with diagnosed endometriosis, migraine, or both endometriosis and migraine
2. Healthy control subjects with no history of chronic pain
3. Age 12-45
4. Assigned female sex at birth

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
2. Presence of prolactinoma
3. Presence of psychiatric, neurological, endocrinological and/or developmental conditions and taking medications for these conditions
4. Current use of dopamine agonist or SSRI medications
5. For patients aged 12-17 not having a parent/legal guardian willing to sign the consent and answer surveys about their child's health
